Name: Green Coconut Tree Sapling
Author: azyzzel
Description:
This modified coconut tree works like any other fruit trees. It produces young green coconuts, thus differs from that found in the Calico Desert which doesn't bear fruit on the tree itself. 

The tree changes according to season only bearing fruit during the summer, and dormant the rest of the year.

[b]INSTALLATION GUIDE:[/b]
1. Install latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JsonAssets[/url].
3. Extract zip file of this mod into the Mods folder of Stardew Valley.


[b]UNINSTALLATION GUIDE:
[/b]1. Remove all trees and fruit.
2. Delete folder from Mods folder.

Optional:
- You can edit the coconut itself using photoshop. I have left a .psd file inside the objects folder.

If you like this mod, please leave an endorsement. I would appreciate it :)
